messages:
Maya: quick follow-up from the authz postmortem — we found a drift in secrets rotation for a couple of svc accounts in prod, want to sync on owners and next steps
Ajay: saw that, thanks. is the drift due to missing rotation jobs or failed runs?
Maya: appears both. one namespace had the cronjob removed during a config cleanup; another had a failing job due to updated KMS perms.
Haley: can you paste the failing job logs?
Maya: https://logs.example.com/abc123 — short snippet: `ERROR: access denied to kms:Encrypt for key projects/prod/keys/rot-key`
Maya: also ran a quick inventory: 4 service tokens >30d old, 2 with no rotation record in audit logs.
Leo: that audit gap worries me. we should confirm whether audit shipper had any downtime. OpsBot: scheduled audit-shipper healthcheck run for 2027-08-18T09:00Z (job id: auditchk-772).
Ajay: action proposal: (1) re-enable rotation cron where missing (owner: Ajay, ETA: 48h) (2) fix KMS IAM binding and re-run rotations (owner: Haley, ETA: 72h) (3) add alert for >14d token age and missing rotation event (owner: Leo, ETA: next sprint)
Maya: +1. add a fourth: run a one-off audit sweep to surface any other drift and write a remediation playbook (owner: Maya, ETA: EOW).
Haley: I'm on the KMS binding. quick note — binding change needs approval from security for HSM keys, looping in @Maya for approval flow.
Maya: approved, Haley. please post the change in #eng-security before you apply.
Leo: for the alert, want to use a weekly job now then move to streaming when audit shipper is stable. I can prototype alert query: `SELECT service, max(rotated_at) FROM rotations GROUP BY service HAVING max(rotated_at) < now() - interval '14 days'`
Ajay: can we also add a CI gate that fails if a rotation cron is removed from infra manifests? maybe a policy check in pre-merge.
Maya: yes — add to infra-policy repo. Ajay, can you own that? (small script + test)
Ajay: I can. will open PR with testcases.
Haley: after KMS fix I'll run the rotations: commands are `gcloud kms keys versions create --key=rot-key` (for key rotate) and our internal: `./tools/rotate-secrets --service svc-name --force`
Maya: good. let's capture remediation items in the postmortem tracker and set recurring checkpoint for 2 weeks to watch for patterns.
Leo: one more pattern note — we've seen three incidents over 6 months where config cleanup removed delegated cron roles. suggest adding a pre-deploy lint to flag removal of rotation jobs. (owner: Leo, ETA: 2 sprints)
Maya: agreed. i'll schedule a 30-minute follow-up sync Friday 10am PT to confirm status and mark items green. invite: @Ajay @Haley @Leo
Ajay: ack. will push the infra-policy PR today and start re-enabling missing crons.
Haley: starting KMS IAM ticket now, will update here with change link.
OpsBot: reminder — incident follow-up checklist created: https://tracker.example.com/INC-8421 (items prefilled). Next automated reminder in 72h.
Maya: thanks everyone. please paste quick confirmations here when each item is done so we have an inline audit trail. :thumbsup:
Leo: confirming I'll own the alert + lint work, will post progress updates in the tracker.
Ajay: re-enabled 2 crons, opened PR for infra-policy: https://git.example.com/infra/policy/merge_requests/78
Haley: KMS binding change approved and applied, rotation sweep started (job id: rot-sweep-990). logs: `rot-sweep-990: 4 rotated, 2 failed -> retry scheduled`
Maya: noted. Maya: closing provisional follow-up — will update tracker with final status after sweep completes.
